mapper.select: SELECT s.fqn AS "fqn" , s.package_name AS "packageName" , f.file_id AS "fileId" , f.path AS "path" , f.encoding AS "encoding" , f.language_level AS "languageLevel" FROM analysis_symbol s JOIN analysis_file f ON f.file_id = s.file_id WHERE s.revision_id = #{revisionId} AND s.fqn = #{fqn} ORDER BY s.file_id LIMIT 1

SELECT file_id AS "fileId" , path AS "path" , package_name AS "packageName" , encoding AS "encoding" , language_level AS "languageLevel" FROM analysis_file WHERE revision_id = #{revisionId} AND language = 'JAVA' AND parse_status = 'OK' ORDER BY file_id LIMIT #{limit}
